# Medcare

> Medcare helps Medicare patients access Annual Wellness Visits (AWV) and Community Health Integration (CHI) services from home. We serve seniors, caregivers, and families navigating Medicare benefits, care coordination, and social determinants of health barriers. Call (800) 303-1766.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://medcaretelehealth.org/): Overview of Medcare services, Medicare AWV and CHI eligibility, how it works, costs, FAQ
- [Check Eligibility](https://medcaretelehealth.org/check-eligibility/): Free online eligibility check for Medicare-covered services
- [Schedule](https://medcaretelehealth.org/schedule/): Schedule an appointment with the Medcare care team
- [Blog](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/): Educational articles about Medicare benefits, CHI services, and senior care
- [Resource Guides](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/): Comprehensive topic guides grouping related articles

## Resource Guides (Topic Clusters)

- [Food Assistance](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/food-assistance/): Food access, Meals on Wheels, SNAP, nutrition programs, and grocery help for seniors on Medicare
- [Transportation](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/transportation/): Free rides to doctor appointments, non-emergency medical transportation, driving alternatives for seniors
- [Medication Costs](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/medication-costs/): Extra Help, Medicare Part D, patient assistance programs, lowering prescription drug costs
- [Caregiver Support](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/caregiver-support/): Caregiver burnout, managing appointments, care coordination, help for family caregivers
- [Senior Isolation](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/senior-isolation/): Health effects of loneliness, warning signs of isolation, Medicare-covered support services
- [Medicare Navigation](https://medcaretelehealth.org/resources/medicare-navigation/): Annual Wellness Visits, CHI, care management, understanding Medicare benefits

- [What Is Community Health Integration (CHI)?](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/what-is-community-health-integration/): Medicare-covered CHI benefit explained — what it includes, who qualifies, how it works

- [Medicare Help Affording Medications](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/medicare-help-affording-medications/): Programs and strategies to reduce prescription drug costs on Medicare
- [Medicare Help for Isolated Seniors](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/medicare-help-for-isolated-seniors/): Social isolation support through Medicare-covered services
- [Medicare Help with Transportation to Appointments](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/medicare-help-with-transportation-to-appointments/): Transportation barriers and Medicare-covered solutions
- [Caregiver Burnout and Medicare Support](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/caregiver-burnout-and-medicare-support/): Recognizing caregiver burnout and how Medicare services can help
- [Elderly Parent Can't Drive Anymore](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/elderly-parent-cant-drive-anymore-what-to-do/): What to do when an aging parent stops driving — planning, alternatives, Medicare support
- [Elderly Parent Living Alone](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/elderly-parent-living-alone-help/): Safety, support, and Medicare-covered services for seniors living alone
- [Elderly Parent Not Eating Properly](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/elderly-parent-not-eating-properly/): Nutrition concerns for aging parents and how CHI services can address them

- [Help Getting Food for Elderly Seniors: Programs and Resources](https://medcaretelehealth.org/blog/help-getting-food-for-elderly-seniors/): 2026-07-28
